definition.source: FORMA original manually authored whole-body key poses; offline constrained skeletal bake, not motion capture
definition.startingPosition: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, soft knees, relaxed shoulders and arms. Move only at a comfortable height.
definition.safety: No equipment. Stop for pain, dizziness or unsteadiness. The coach does not measure your form.
definition.modifications: Use a smaller knee lift. Skip if unable to balance. This authored standing exercise is not a seated adaptation.
definition.pauseBehavior: Freeze exact sampled pose and authoritative workout clock; resume without replaying passed events. On stop blend back to planted neutral.
